verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs say that including a Jira issue key in commits links them and updates Jira issue status automatically. They also mention a built-in Jira UI and opening Jira tickets from the PR screen, but linking existing pull requests to issues is only implied. The capability depends on Jira and is backed only by marketing-level product-page claims. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of linking PRs to issues, details of commit-message syntax and status transitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link commits and pull requests to issues and have issue status update automatically from commit messages

citations.quote: when you include your issue key in commits, your Jira issue statuses update automatically.
open Jira tickets right from the PR screen
